reason: Post-result comparator audit: ordinary CUSUM need not reset on every arriving packet. Test retained cumulative state across messages, with alarm resets, under the same cache isolation action
tune_rule: Eight fixed geometric bracket iterations, multipliers [0.05,40], update each phase using its realized NORMAL complete-episode alarm rate; finalize geometric midpoint, audit independently, no test retuning
shared_assets: phase normal moments, base score thresholds, cap and half-life frozen from source run; no test-based retuning
causal_whitening: same within-cache conditional innovation as first benchmark; cross-cache independence is NOT assumed, normal episode maxima are empirically calibrated
reset_rule: retain detector sums on a new packet; reset sums after each threshold crossing; rejected cache stays isolated until replaced. All evidence current/past only
primary: mean vs both carry baselines for primary-edge step under both schedules:4 tests for >=1% receiverMSE improvement, Holm4; half-step and external edge are boundary checks
decision: If even this stronger comparator is surpassed, retain only sustained-full-bias engineering signal, not generic detector novelty. If false-isolation matching fails, flag incomparable and do not use test data to tune again
